# TacoBoutIT: Taco Bell menu prices across the US

> An independent price study. Not affiliated with Taco Bell or Yum! Brands. Weekly snapshot of online pickup prices at 7,743 restaurants, collected 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-24.

Machine-readable guide with every file, column and caveat: https://tacobout.domoretech.net/data/index.json

## Caveats

- Online pickup prices from Taco Bell's ordering site, not in-store menu boards.
- Before tax, before deals, rewards or app-only offers.
- Each restaurant is counted under the city on its mailing address.
- Every figure traces to a collected price; nothing is estimated. A missing price is null.
- Prices change; this is one weekly snapshot, dated below.
- The site and these files were built with AI help. The prices are collected, not generated, but summaries and labels can contain mistakes. Report one at https://github.com/domoretechnet/tacobout-data/issues.

## Files

- [data/dashboard.json](https://tacobout.domoretech.net/data/dashboard.json): Headline numbers and the item catalogue. meta = collection run; items = every item with national median/min/max and coverage; states = per-state 12-item median, min, max; featured = the 40 item codes that per-restaurant files are aligned to; store_columns / city_columns = column order for stores.json and cities.json. (154 KB)
- [data/stores.json](https://tacobout.domoretech.net/data/stores.json): array of arrays, one per restaurant, in store_columns order (985 KB)
- [data/cities.json](https://tacobout.domoretech.net/data/cities.json): array of arrays, one per city, in city_columns order (312 KB)
- [data/state/{ST}.json](https://tacobout.domoretech.net/data/state/TX.json): Per-restaurant prices for one state: {store id: [price per featured item]}. Position i is dashboard.json featured[i]; null = not sold there. (1,632 KB)
- [data/item/{code}.json](https://tacobout.domoretech.net/data/item/22100.json): One item across states: by_state median, state_min, state_max, state_counts, and hist = [[price, restaurants], ...]. Codes are in dashboard.json items. (396 KB)
- [data/books.json](https://tacobout.domoretech.net/data/books.json): Price books: groups of restaurants charging identical prices, with their states and towns. (144 KB)
- [data/places.json](https://tacobout.domoretech.net/data/places.json): Census places of min_pop or more: [name, state, population, lat, lon, tier]. Used for city search. (225 KB)

## Every price

The files above carry the 40 featured items per restaurant. The full table (every restaurant x every item, CSV) is a release download: https://github.com/domoretechnet/tacobout-data/releases/latest

## Use

The data files listed here are free to use, including commercially. Please credit TacoBoutIT with a link to https://tacobout.domoretech.net wherever you publish something built on them. This covers the data only: the site's design, code, text and artwork are not licensed for reuse.

## Fetching

Plain static files, updated weekly. Download what you need once and cache it; everything together is a few MB.
